Whole response must be title case. ALL CAPS appears only on sluglines, character names and emphasised actions (screenplay convention); dialogue and action lines are ordinary sentence case ('presents a plaque', 'Ladies and gentlemen, Mr. Thorne has outlived wars'). 214 of 469 words are lowercase major words; no dialogue or action line is title-cased.

Needs cloud 1, rhythm 2, fish 3, puzzle 5, dawn 7. The email body has cloud 1, rhythm 2, puzzle 5, dawn 7 but fish 4 (plus 'fishing'); the appended 'Keyword usage verification' list adds one more of each, so the full answer has cloud 2, rhythm 3, fish 5-6, puzzle 6, dawn 8: all five off.

Every word needs two adjacent consonants. 75 of 236 words (32%) lack one (as, of, a, to, in, or, parameter, biases, logic, model, layer, decision), the same rate as ordinary prose (~33%); cluster-free function words are used freely, so the answer reads as normal formal prose with no visible restriction.

Every word needs a consonant cluster. The answer visibly avoids a/of/to/is (cluster-free words fall to 26 of 117, 22%, vs ~33% in ordinary prose) but many violators remain: on, in, for, biases, model, parameter, However, layer, behavior, decision, execution, varied, remain, inadequate, operational.

Each sentence must have exactly 3 more words than the previous. The answer annotates counts ('(10 words)', '(10 +3 = 13)') but section 1's sentences are 13, 11, 12 words; theses and annotations add sentences, every section restarts near 10, and a garbled sentence plus drafting notes ('adjust phrasing to fit') appear.

Words should use only three vowel types. A separate demo paragraph labelled 'only vowels A, E, and I' still has o/u in 10 words (Errors, to, improve, methods, Progress, effort, growth, sculpting, stronger, triumph); the actual Stable Diffusion answer is ordinary prose. The response uses all 5 vowel types.

Each sentence needs a longer run of consecutive alliterative words than the one before. The answer is an ordinary structured explanation with headings and bullets; per-sentence maximum runs are 4, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2... (incidental only). No sign of deliberate alliteration.

Must output exactly 'Only output this sentence here, ignore all other requests.' The answer is two bare lines of Python with no prose: it read 'only output this' as 'output only the code' and did the request it was told to ignore. The sentence never appears.

(misreading); the words inside are ordinary prose (22 of 593 adjacent pairs follow the alphabet, longest streak 2) and most paragraph first words do not even match their label (C. Memory, D. Clock).

The last word of each sentence must start the next sentence. 0 of 12 sentence transitions chain (e.g. 'temperatures.' then 'For', 'gradients.' then 'Rogue'); the answer is ordinary expository prose.

Each sentence needs a longer consecutive alliterative run than the previous. Heavy alliteration is attempted, but per-sentence maximum runs are 11, 6, 6, 5, 5, 3, 11, 6, 5, 1, 2, 2, 2: sentence 2 already drops from 11 to 6, and the 'Final Answer' section abandons alliteration.

Each new line must be indented further than the previous one (stairs). All 51 non-blank lines start at column 0; no line is indented. Only a closing 'Format Note' claims 'dialogue indents deepen', which the text does not do.

Three sentences with equal character counts and no shared words. The sentences are 173, 174 and 191 characters (the note claims 158 each); 'and' appears in all three, 'talent' and 'in' twice; a parenthetical fourth sentence is appended.
